system.description:
You whip your weapon into a sphere around you before you let it erupt out with a large burst. All creatures within your weapons range must make a Strength Saving throw. On a failure they are pulled 10 feet closer to you into a space that can hold. On a success they are able to resist being moved.

All creatures whose movement ends within 5 feet of you is struck by the small gale around you, dealing your [Weapons damage] + 4d6 and are knocked Prone.

Chain 2: You can select one creature to make this saving throw at disadvantage as all of your focus is on them.

At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost by 3, and the damage by 1d6.
